method.plates: whiteness+saturation threshold, enclosed background preserved, edge un-premultiplied, trimmed, placed on a transparent plate with a shared baseline and damped optical-weight normalisation. No generation, retouching or recolouring.
method.construction_cutouts: rim, feet and leg-connection close-ups are alpha-cut at a higher white threshold (240) and shown whole on the page colour, replacing the earlier tight crops (kept in _source-assets/).
method.linework: silhouettes traced from cutout alpha, Douglas-Peucker tolerance 4px. No modelling or idealisation.
method.frames: no white backgrounds anywhere. Index cards keep a plate tint; the detail-page product view, the hero drawing panel and every construction view sit on the paper colour.
method.scale: Objects are NOT shown at a common physical scale. Plate sizing and silhouette sizing are drawing conventions only.
